channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Tigers take down Eagles, 71-34, in first meeting
item.description: Wilson Prep routed Sallie B. Howard 74-31 in the charter rivals' first ECAC hoops meeting, moving the Tigers into a tie atop the league while the Eagles continue to struggle in their first NCHSAA season.

item.title: 'Hat Lady’ donates warmth, one stitch at a time
item.description: At 76, longtime crocheter Linda Little has turned her former festival business into a mission, donating hundreds of handmade hats and scarves to children and adults in need.

item.title: Barton women dominate boards, Erskine for third straight league victory
item.description: Barton women roll past Erskine 76-52, riding a 65-41 rebounding edge and 28 forced turnovers for their third straight Conference Carolinas win.

item.title: Bulldogs bury 17 treys in rout of winless Fleet
item.description: Barton drills 17 3-pointers in 92-56 rout of winless Erskine, extending its streak to three behind Sean Quick-Streeter’s 18 points and a 58% shooting night on the road.

item.title: Hunt fights past CBA to keep share of Big East lead
item.description: Hunt rebounds from its first Big East loss with a 52-38 win at C.B. Aycock, completing the sweep and keeping a share of the conference lead with Fike.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 26-27, 2026
item.description: Area sports schedule for Jan. 26-27, 2026, featuring high school boys, girls and JV basketball, wrestling at Eastern Wayne, and Catawba at Barton in men’s volleyball.

item.title: Wilson iced over after winter storm
item.description: A winter storm coated Wilson with sleet and ice, leaving slick roads but no power outages as a few residents ventured out. Officials urged drivers to stay home or use caution.

item.title: Wake Forest’s 29-year drought in Durham continues as Duke rolls at Cameron
item.description: Duke extends Wake Forest’s 29-year drought in Durham, rolling 90-69 at Cameron as Cameron Boozer scores 32 and the Blue Devils dominate the boards for their 26th straight home win.

item.title: Warriors’ Harris wins Big East title, crowned league’s top wrestler
item.description: Hunt junior Judah Harris captured the 5-A/6-A Big East Wrestler of the Year award and 215-pound title, leading the Warriors to fourth as Northern Nash dominated the conference championships.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of Jan. 12-16
item.description: Wilson County recorded 32 property deed transfers for Jan. 12-16, including a 24.6-acre N.C. 42 West tract that sold for $1.25 million and an $870,000 Frossie Court home in Sims.
